title: File:Bali Jatra in Guinness Book of World Records - an initiative by CMC and Mayor Subhash Singh.jpg
desc: The famous Cuttack Bali Jatra today etched its name in the Guinness Book of World Records at an event organized by the Cuttack Municipal Corporation (CMC). Mayor Subhash Singh, Comission Pawan Kalyan and Cuttack Collector Bhabani Shankar Chayani recived the award.

title: File:Guinness Book of Records "Make it 1803" Guitar Record Breaking Attempt.jpg
desc: Over 1600 musicians and guitars turned out at the Festival of Friends in Gage Park, Hamilton, ON, Canada on August 8th, 2009 in an attempt to break the Guinness Record for most guitars playing simultaneously.

title: File:1,500 People Space Hop Into The Guinness Book Of World Records (3).jpg
desc:
1,500 People take part in a Guinness World Record attempt on Sunday afternoon at 2pm.
At 2pm on Sunday 20th June on Upper Mount St, Dublin 2, outside the Pepper Canister Church, at least 1,500 people established a new world record for the most people bouncing on space hoppers at once.
